snippet.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour | Multiplayer First-Look
snippet.description:
More friends, more fares, more fun!  Get a first look at the Multiplayer in Crazy Taxi: World Tour and see how you can go crazy, together.  See the multiplayer action first-hand in the Closed Network Test - signups available until August 31st, 2026!
 
Join the Discord and learn more about getting priority access: https://discord.gg/XczTRMpdu3

Sign up for a chance to participate in the Multiplayer Closed Network Test by August 31st, 2026 at: https://www.sega.com/crazy-taxi/crazy-taxi-world-tour?tab=closed-network-test    
 
Wishlist Now on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Steam.
